content.rendered:
“Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.” (Luke 5: 4)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

In our Focal Scripture, after He had left speaking to the multitude, Jesus turned to Peter and told him to let down his nets for a draught. Peter was not the only person who heard Jesus speak. There was a multitude that also heard, but when it was miracle time, Jesus singled out Peter. There were many more persons that would have needed miracles there, they all heard the word but one person got the miracle.

Friend, there may be many persons who have heard the same words you heard, there may be many persons who received the same prophecies you received, there may be many persons who made themselves available in the atmosphere that births miracles, but God says, you will be the first to show up with evidence. There will be a speedy manifestation of the word of the Lord that you have heard.

Hear me as I hear the Lord: you will show up with evidence. You will receive a manifestation of the power of God in your life. What others may have only heard, you will see it with your eyes. What others may not have experienced by the hand of the Lord, you will experience it first hand. What others are still praying for shall become your reality. In the same place where others may have been empty handed, your hands shall be full.

There were multitudes that heard the same word that Peter heard, but Peter was the first to come forth with a miracle. He was the first to receive evidence after the interface with the word of the Lord. Hear me as I hear the Lord: you shall be the first to show up with results. You will be the first to emerge with evidence of the efforts that others may have also made. You will be the first to step into your high places.

Get set to receive the evidence of every word you have heard from God; get set to manifest concrete evidence of the word of the Lord.

Malachi 1: 5 says: “And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.”

Declare With Me: I show forth with evidence; every word of God I hear shall birth an evidence, in Jesus’ name!
